summary: 64-year-old man snowshoeing with a family member collapsed about a third of a mile from the Green Mountain trailhead on a Saturday afternoon; Grand County Sheriff's Department received the cell-phone call. NPS RMNP rangers and area emergency personnel responded within minutes, provided advanced medical care, but were unable to revive him; pronounced dead at the scene.
location: Green Mountain trailhead area, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers; Grand County emergency services
notes: NPS morning-report compendium entry dated Tue 2012-02-21 ('Visitor Dies While Snowshoeing In Park'); incident Saturday afternoon = 2012-02-18 (weekday-verified). Distinct from id 2798 (same-date Odessa Lake unconscious woman) in the same report. Victim name not published; URL parent-opened run 553.
